page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the left margin (italic short notes) and right margin edge. Running head at top with page number 776 at left and title "Leo Isauricus" with "Lib. IV." at right.

main_text.p: illud damnavit, & amicitiâ cum Longobardis initâ, ejusdem, vim intentari volentis, tributa in Italia atque Romæ inhibuit. Leo, cum admi­niftros fuos, edictum de imaginibus exequen­tes, nonnulli ex plebe interimerent, acriter tum in illos, cum in alios levius fe opponen­tet animadvertit, & Monachos aliquot cum libris & lupellectilem Cænobio exullit. Hinc Grego­rius fœdus cum Carolo Martello † pepigit, & Leonem * excommunicavit. Leo, cum vi nihil contra Pontificem efficere poffet, ex infidiis eum, ut lediriofum, tollere, fed fruftrà, voluit. Johannes Damafceno Chryforroæ, in aula Saracenica degenti, & Epifcopos ad retinendas imagines in citanti ingens periculum creavit. Germanum denique, Patriarcham Conftantinopolitanum, fi­bi obtrectantem, in ex lium ejecit. Nec minores Anastaf. in Gregor. III.fub Gregorio III. Gregorii † fuccelfore turbe fue re. Nam etfi hic fupplicibus duntaxat & com­monitoriis, libellis, rem imaginum ageret fru­ftrà tamen fuit, imo Imperator, challenged cantra eum mifit, hacin finu Adriatico tempeftatibus disjectâ, ejus in Sicilia & Calabria redditus, quæ fe ad VIIIM aureorum extendebant, in fifcum redegit, Theophylactum, Nicomedienfem Epi­fcopum, pepulit, & Monachorum quibusdam cutem in capite detraxit, aliis barbam pice li­quenti illitam accendit, nonnullos ad perpetuos Annal.Frif.carceres condemnavit. Sub eo Carolus Martel­lus, inftigante Willebrodo, Frifios ad recipien­dam religionem Chriftianam, lucis, fatus, & ido­lis eorum fubverfis, adegit. Bonifacius, Germa­nia Epifcopus, an conjugium ejus diffolvendum Baron. T. 9. lit.

page.notes: Marginal notes are small and partly cut off at the margins; the left-margin references read "Cadrenus", "Anastaf. in Gregor. III.", "Annal.Frif.", "Baron. T. 9." and the right margin is badly damaged. Several words at line ends in the right margin are illegible. Reconstruction of marginal text is uncertain.
